'''Power Junction K-H82''' was a power junction located in the [[District 1327|Breaktown]] of [[Zakuul]].<ref name="SWTOR" /> In [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_updates" /> during the [[War against Zakuul]], [[Kaliyo Djannis]] and [[Alliance Commander|the Alliance Commander]] wired an [[Ion grenade/Legends|ion grenade]] into the Power Junction and later detonated it to disable the [[Overwatch]] security.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Power Junction K-H82 appears as an area on Zakuul during "Chapter 10: Anarchy in Paradise" of the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' expansion.<ref name="SWTOR" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' {{1st}}
